calls.statement: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads FROM fact_sales_line
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS d_id, min(return_date), max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT (sale_date, store_key, product_key, quantity, net_amount, sale_ts_utc)) AS dv, min(sale_date) d0, max(sale_date) d1 FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT c, dv, count(*), min(d0), max(d1) FROM dups GROUP BY 1,2

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.store_id, cs.store_name, round(m.net_sales,2) mine, round(c.ctl_net,2) ctl, round(m.net_sales-c.ctl_net,2) diff
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=m.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY m.net_sales DESC

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(DISTINCT n.business_date) FILTER (WHERE n.net_sales>0) AS sale_days
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date GROUP BY 1,2
),
r AS (SELECT *, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rk, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY net_sales/sale_days DESC) AS rk_day FROM agg)
SELECT fiscal_year, rk, store_id, round(net_sales,0) ns, sale_days, rk_day, round(net_sales/sale_days,0) per_day FROM r WHERE rk<=12 OR rk_day<=12 ORDER BY fiscal_year, rk

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM sl f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales) DESC) AS rank, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
GROUP BY cs.store_id, cs.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
